id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|17e: Everyone, do not forget this warning... Do not become like Rab. ~From High Priest Sampo

id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|1d5: One theory says it is made from a branch of Yggdrasil, so sturdy it survives a giant dragon's tread, with power to shatter steel.
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|1e7: The rod's punishment on monks who break temperance is famous; the pain could split one's bottom in two.

id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|223: Among them, Kakachichimorocha, made only for festivals, is no exaggeration the world's best dish.
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|233: Kakachichimorocha also means "proud self": a dish to be proud of after climbing the harsh path here.
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|24e: It's a difficult-looking book called "Treatise on the Heavenly Holy Mountain."
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|254: The master said: people are of the world, and the world of people. To serve the world with goodness protects it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|262: The master said: there is joy after hardship; there is learning after sorrow. Love, love! People and this world.
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|26d: This is truly the aspiration of the children of Angri-La, born on the holy mountain that pierces the heavens.
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|28c: It's a travel magazine called "Madame Travels Alone: A Busy Madame's Day Trip from Angri-La to Puerto Valor."
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|29a: On a late morning, I gaze at the Soltchia canal and eat coconut sauce pancakes. Soltiana coffee is a must.
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|2a7: Afterward I lean on a wooden beach chair, reading and nibbling tropical fruit. Its freshness makes me forget the heat.
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|2b3: At night, after playing the famed casino, dinner at the resort hotel's restaurant. The acqua pazza here is divine.
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|2bf: Finally, on the beach tavern's terrace, I sip a sunflower Rising Cocktail and fall for the owner again and again...
id./param/region/r015.pack|book_ie.bxon|2ce: ...That is a Puerto Valor madame's life. If you're the least bit interested, do come vacation in Puerto Valor.

tm.勇者ローシュ 魔法使いウラノス\n我ら 志を同じくする 永遠の友として\n共に: Luminary Erdwin and wizard Uranos: as eternal friends of one purpose, we here swear to defeat the evil god together.
tm.「待つのだ。この先は ドゥーランダ山頂に\n つながる山道だが 多くの魔物がいる: "Wait. This path leads to Mount Pang Lai's summit, full of monsters. None may enter without permission.
tm.ロウが やせこけて ミイラのようになっている。\n長い時間 この体勢のまま 動い: Rab has grown gaunt and mummy-like. He seems to have stayed in this posture for a long time.
tm.その足元には ムフフ本の中でも 最高と名高い\n『ピチピチ★バニー』が 落ちてい: At his feet lies "Pichi Pichi Bunny," renowned as the finest of naughty books.
tm.皆さん 気落ちしていると 思いますが\nいつまでも 悲しみに 暮れてはいけません: Everyone, you must be disheartened, but do not mourn forever. Heaven helps those who help themselves...
tm.今は 故人に哀悼の意を示して\n自分ができる 精一杯の修行をしましょう\n～サン: For now, honor the departed and do the best training you can. ~From High Priest Sampo
tm.今も 世界中の人々を苦しめる\n魔王ウルノーガの軍勢と 戦うため\n我々も 強く: To fight Mordegon's forces that still torment people worldwide, we must grow stronger.
tm.ドゥルダの大修練場で 連武討魔行に挑戦して\nおのれの身体を 鍛えましょう\n～: Challenge the Grand Trial of Martial Might at Angri-La's training ground and temper your body. ~From High Priest Sampo
tm.大師のカタキ……魔王ウルノーガは\n{var:1}さんによって 討ち果たされまし: The Master's enemy, Mordegon, was defeated by {var:1}, but our training never ends.
tm.ロウさまは イタズラで 霊廟の石碑をキズつけ\n怒った大師さまに お尻をたたかれ: Lord Rab scratched the mausoleum tablet as a prank, and the angry Master spanked him. His bottom swelled bright red.
tm.皆さん この戒めを忘れてはなりません\n……ロウのようになることなかれ\n～サン: Everyone, do not forget this warning... Do not become like Rab. ~From High Priest Sampo
tm.これより東に ドゥーランダ山頂へ通ずる道あり\nただし 郷の許しのない者は 入る: East of here is the road to the summit of Mount Pang Lai. Those without the village's permission must not enter.
tm.『受け継がれし お尻たたき棒』という本だ。: It's a book called "The Inherited Spanking Rod."
tm.ドゥルダ郷の大師がふるう 伝説の武具を\nごぞんじか？ 海を割る剣？ 雲を落とす: Know the legendary weapon of Angri-La's Master? A sea-splitting sword? A cloud-dropping staff? No: the spanking rod.
tm.お尻たたき棒の起源は 里の興りまで さかのぼり\n秘めたる不思議なチカラによって: The rod dates to the village's founding; its hidden power is said to guide and choose the Master.
tm.一説によれば 命の大樹の枝から 作られており\n巨竜に踏まれようとも 壊れぬ頑丈: One theory says it is made from a branch of Yggdrasil, so sturdy it survives a giant dragon's tread, with power to shatter steel.
tm.節制を破った僧に対して お尻たたき棒の刑が\n炸裂することは 有名な話であるが\: The rod's punishment on monks who break temperance is famous; the pain could split one's bottom in two.
tm.『魅惑のドゥルダ料理』という本だ。: It's a book called "Enchanting Angri-La Cuisine."
tm.ドゥルダ料理は 厳しい修行に挑む 僧たちが\n質素ながらも 栄養価の高い食事を望: Angri-La cuisine is said to have developed as vegetarian fare when monks in harsh training sought plain yet nutritious meals.
tm.なかでも ドゥルダ郷の祭事にのみ 作られる\nカカチチモロッチャという 特別な料: Among them, Kakachichimorocha, made only for festivals, is no exaggeration the world's best dish.
tm.カカチチモロッチャには 誇らしい自分という\n意味もあるらしい。まさに 厳しい山: Kakachichimorocha also means "proud self": a dish to be proud of after climbing the harsh path here.
tm.『天空霊山論説』という むずかしそうな本だ。: It's a difficult-looking book called "Treatise on the Heavenly Holy Mountain."
tm.師いわく 人は世なれ 世は人なれ。\n善をつくして 世に 仕えること\nこれまさ: The master said: people are of the world, and the world of people. To serve the world with goodness protects it.
tm.師いわく 苦ありて 楽あり。\n悲しみありて 学びあり。\n愛せ 愛せよ。人と: The master said: there is joy after hardship; there is learning after sorrow. Love, love! People and this world.
tm.人世善世 苦楽悲学 愛愛人世。\nこれまさに 天空をつく 霊山に生まれし\nドゥ: This is truly the aspiration of the children of Angri-La, born on the holy mountain that pierces the heavens.
tm.『マダム一人旅 ～忙しいマダムの 日帰り旅行\nドゥルダ郷から行く ソルティコの: It's a travel magazine called "Madame Travels Alone: A Busy Madame's Day Trip from Angri-La to Puerto Valor."
tm.遅く起きた朝は ソルッチャ運河を見つめながら\nココナッツソースの パンケーキを: On a late morning, I gaze at the Soltchia canal and eat coconut sauce pancakes. Soltiana coffee is a must.
tm.その後 ビーチのウッドチェアに もたれて\n読書しながら 南国フルーツをひとかじ: Afterward I lean on a wooden beach chair, reading and nibbling tropical fruit. Its freshness makes me forget the heat.
tm.夜になって 名物のカジノで遊んだ後は\nリゾートホテルのレストランで ディナータ: At night, after playing the famed casino, dinner at the resort hotel's restaurant. The acqua pazza here is divine.
tm.最後は ビーチをのぞむ 酒場のテラスで\nひまわり色の ライジングカクテルを飲み: Finally, on the beach tavern's terrace, I sip a sunflower Rising Cocktail and fall for the owner again and again...
tm.……以上が ソルティコマダムの生活ですわ。\nすこしでも 興味をお持ちになったな: ...That is a Puerto Valor madame's life. If you're the least bit interested, do come vacation in Puerto Valor.
